thread.title: Broadcom stock gains after Evercore initiates with bullish rating

author: Emily Bary
title: Broadcom stock gains after Evercore initiates with bullish rating
text: Shares of Broadcom Inc. AVGO, +0.13% are up 0.6% in premarket trading after Evercore ISI analyst C.J. Muse initiated coverage of the stock with an outperform rating. "Broadcom is a collection of twenty sticky franchise businesses with world-class margins, a dominant market-leading position in each, and an oligopoly type industry structure with strong barriers to entry and pricing power driven by differentiated value to end-customers," wrote Muse, who has a $300 price target on the stock. He said that fears over disappointing Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.79% iPhone sales numbers are currently priced in. Muse sees "aggressive" buyback activity and margin improvement as potential catalysts for the stock, which is little changed over the past 12 months. The S&P 500 SPX, -0.67% has gained 14% in that time, and the PHLX Semiconductor Index phlx is up 28%.
